step_1.vision: Every machine on the floor reports its state before anyone touches it.
step_1.problem_statement: Operators cannot tell which spindles are live.
step_1.target_users: Machinists, shop leads and maintenance planners.

needs.capability: a live view of each spindle that is running
needs.outcome: I can clear the floor before maintenance

needs.capability: to see who started a job
needs.outcome: I can follow up on near misses

needs.capability: a weekly list of machines due for service
needs.outcome: downtime is planned, not forced

requirements.text: The system shall stop the spindle and lock the guard within one second of an operator pressing any emergency stop button.
requirements.fit_criterion: Measured from button press to spindle at rest

requirements.text: The system shall record which badge started each job and show it on the machine panel until the job is cleared by a lead
requirements.fit_criterion: Shown until a lead clears it

requirements.text: The system shall list the machines due for service each Monday
requirements.fit_criterion: Matches the maintenance plan
